name: Vice Savings Calculator
meta_title: Vice Savings Calculator: What Quitting a Habit Is Worth
meta_description: See what quitting or cutting back smoking, drinking, gambling or another habit would save each month and grow to if you invested the money instead.
subtitle: Add up to three habits, such as smoking, drinking or gambling, say what each costs and how much you’ll cut it, and see what the money you keep could grow to and how soon it reaches a goal.
